desc: A global `rule` expressing data truth after every mutation compiles.
exercise:
field Score as integer
rule Score >= 680 because "Credit score too low"

desc: A guarded rule (`rule ... when <cond> because ...`) applies conditionally and compiles.
exercise:
field DownPayment as currency in USD
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD
field LoanType as string
rule DownPayment >= RequestedAmount * 0.20 when LoanType == "conventional" because "Conventional loans require 20% down"

desc: Rules operate in field scope and cannot reference event arguments.
exercise:
event Submit(Amount as integer)
rule Submit.Amount > 0 because "..."

desc: Residency ensure `in <State> ensure ...` compiles.
exercise:
state Review
field Reviewers as list of string
in Review ensure Reviewers.count >= 2 because "Review requires at least two reviewers"

desc: Entry ensure `to <State> ensure ...` checked on transitions into the state compiles.
exercise:
state Review
field Reviewers as list of string
to Review ensure Reviewers.count >= 2 because "..."

desc: Exit ensure `from <State> ensure ...` checked on transitions out of the state compiles.
exercise:
state Open
field Priority as integer
from Open ensure Priority >= 1 because "..."

desc: Event-argument ensure `on <Event> ensure ...` validating caller args compiles.
exercise:
event Submit(Type as string, Amount as integer)
on Submit when Submit.Type == "payment" ensure Submit.Amount > 0 because "Payment amounts must be positive"

desc: A guarded state ensure `in <State> when <cond> ensure ...` compiles.
exercise:
state Open
field Escalated as boolean
field Priority as integer
in Open when Escalated ensure Priority >= 3 because "Escalated tickets must be high priority"

desc: An authored `-> reject "..."` prohibition row is valid surface (authored prohibition, not constraint failure).
exercise:
state Draft
event Cancel
from Draft on Cancel -> reject "Cannot cancel a draft"

desc: `initial` modifier on an event declaration designates the construction event and compiles.
exercise: event Create(ApplicantName as string, Amount as currency in USD, CreditScore as integer) initial

desc: `initial` modifier appears after the event name for a parameterless initial event.
exercise: event Start initial

desc: Only one event per precept may carry `initial`; a second is rejected.
exercise:
event Create(A as integer) initial
event Start(B as integer) initial

desc: Construction rows use the `on <InitialEvent>` form (not `from State on Event`) and compile.
exercise:
event Create(ApplicantName as string, Amount as currency in USD) initial
field ApplicantName as string
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD
on Create
    -> set ApplicantName = Create.ApplicantName
    -> set RequestedAmount = Create.Amount

desc: A guarded construction row `on Create when <cond> -> ...` provides first-match intake routing and compiles.
exercise:
event Create(Amount as currency in USD) initial
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD
on Create when Create.Amount > '0.00 USD'
    -> set RequestedAmount = Create.Amount

desc: A construction reject path `on Create when <cond> -> reject "..."` compiles.
exercise:
event Create(Amount as currency in USD) initial
on Create when Create.Amount <= '0.00 USD'
    -> reject "Loan amount must be positive"

desc: `transition` is structurally excluded from construction rows (grammar-level parse error).
exercise:
state Review
event Create(A as integer) initial
on Create -> transition Review

desc: `no transition` is structurally excluded from construction rows (grammar-level parse error).
exercise:
event Create(A as integer) initial
on Create -> no transition

desc: A transition row `from State on Event -> transition <State>` permits `transition` and compiles.
exercise:
state Draft
state Review
event Submit
from Draft on Submit -> transition Review

desc: Pattern A: initial event populating birth-time existential fields via construction rows compiles.
exercise:
event Create(ApplicantName as string, Amount as currency in USD) initial
field ApplicantName as string
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD
on Create
    -> set ApplicantName = Create.ApplicantName
    -> set RequestedAmount = Create.Amount

desc: Pattern B: no initial event, parameterless Create materializes a governed draft state with progressive enrichment; compiles.
exercise:
state Unlisted
field Title as string default "" editable
field Price as currency in USD default '0.00 USD' editable

desc: Pattern B requires birth-time-absent fields to be optional or defaulted; a required non-optional non-default field with no initial event is rejected.
exercise:
state Unlisted
field Title as string
field Price as currency in USD default '0.00 USD'

desc: With no initial event, `Create()` is parameterless and always succeeds when all fields have defaults or are optional.
exercise:
field Title as string default ""
field Count as integer default 0

desc: A precept with required fields (non-optional, no default) but no initial event cannot produce a valid initial version.
exercise:
field ApplicantName as string
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD

desc: Initial event does not assign all required fields that lack defaults.
exercise:
event Create(Name as string) initial
field Name as string
field RequestedAmount as currency in USD
on Create -> set Name = Create.Name

desc: A required no-default field read inside its own first initial-event assignment observes an undefined value.
exercise:
event Create initial
field Count as integer
on Create -> set Count = Count + 1

desc: An initial-event assignment reads another required field before that field's first assignment in the same action chain.
exercise:
event Create(N as integer) initial
field A as integer
field B as integer
on Create
    -> set A = B + 1
    -> set B = Create.N

desc: Non-initial events cannot use the bare `on <Event>` form in stateful precepts (must use `from State on Event`).
exercise:
state Open
event Touch
on Touch -> set Field = 1
field Field as integer default 0

desc: At least one construction row must be able to produce Created; an initial event whose rows always reject is rejected (AlwaysRejecting promoted to Error for initial events).
exercise:
event Create(Amount as integer) initial
on Create when Create.Amount > 0 -> reject "no"
on Create -> reject "never valid"

desc: The initial event cannot appear in a `from <State> on <InitialEvent>` transition row (fire-once guarantee).
exercise:
state Open
event Create(A as integer) initial
from Open on Create -> no transition

desc: A precept that declares no states is first-class; State is null in the constructed version.
exercise:
field Amount as integer default 0
rule Amount >= 0 because "..."

desc: A stateless precept with an initial event fires it through the standard pipeline and compiles.
exercise:
event Create(Amount as integer) initial
field Amount as integer
on Create -> set Amount = Create.Amount

desc: The graph analyzer is exempt from initial-state reachability checks for stateless precepts (no false structural diagnostic).
exercise: field Amount as integer default 0

desc: The graph analyzer is exempt from dead-end-state checks for stateless precepts.
exercise: field Status as string default ""

desc: The graph analyzer is exempt from unreachable-state checks for stateless precepts.
exercise: field Count as integer default 0

desc: A reachable non-terminal state with no structural path to any terminal is a dead-end/sink and is rejected.
exercise:
state Draft
state Trap
event Go
from Draft on Go -> transition Trap

desc: A state with no incoming transitions (unreachable) is rejected by the unreachable-state check.
exercise:
state Draft
state Orphan
event Go
from Draft on Go -> no transition

desc: A state not reachable from the initial state fails the initial-state reachability check.
exercise:
state Draft
state Review
state Island
event Submit
event Hop
from Draft on Submit -> transition Review
from Island on Hop -> transition Review

desc: The proof engine checks initial-state satisfiability against default values; an initial state whose ensures the defaults cannot satisfy is rejected (PRE0115).
exercise:
state Open
field Amount as integer default 0
in Open ensure Amount >= 10 because "..."

desc: With an initial event and a construction row (IsConstruction), the proof engine skips the default-value satisfiability check for the initial state (no false PRE0115).
exercise:
state Open
event Create(Amount as integer) initial
field Amount as integer default 0
on Create -> set Amount = Create.Amount
in Open ensure Amount >= 10 because "..."

desc: The proof system is conservative: if it cannot prove the required qualifier fact, the program is rejected rather than accepted on a guess (prove-or-reject).
exercise:
field A as decimal
field B as decimal
rule A / B > 1 because "..."

desc: Numeric nonzero obligation: division by a possibly-zero operand must be rejected unless proven nonzero.
exercise:
field Total as decimal
field Qty as decimal
rule Total / Qty > 0 because "..."

desc: Numeric nonnegative obligation: sqrt of a possibly-negative operand must be rejected unless proven nonnegative.
exercise:
field X as decimal
rule sqrt(X) > 0 because "..."

desc: Currency-axis compatibility: arithmetic combining money of different currencies without conversion is rejected.
exercise:
field Usd as currency in USD
field Eur as currency in EUR
rule Usd + Eur > '0.00 USD' because "..."

desc: Conversion-result currency resolution: a same-currency money operation with resolved currency axis compiles.
exercise:
field A as currency in USD
field B as currency in USD
rule A + B >= '0.00 USD' because "..."

desc: Unit compatibility: combining quantities with incompatible units is rejected.
exercise:
field Len as quantity in 'm'
field Mass as quantity in 'kg'
rule Len + Mass > '0 m' because "..."

desc: Dimension compatibility: an operation across incompatible physical dimensions is rejected.
exercise:
field Speed as quantity in 'm/s'
field Len as quantity in 'm'
rule Speed == Len because "..."

desc: Temporal-dimension compatibility: mismatched temporal dimensions in an operation are rejected.
exercise:
field D as date
field Dur as duration in 'h'
rule D + Dur == D because "..."

desc: Declaration-based facts carried by qualifiers/modifiers/presence metadata can discharge an obligation, so the program compiles.
exercise:
field Total as decimal
field Qty as decimal min 1
rule Total / Qty > 0 because "..."

desc: Interval-containment proofs normalize statically-convertible magnitudes to UCUM base units before comparison, so a cross-unit assignment within bounds is proved safe (no false NumericOverflow).
exercise:
field W as quantity in 'kg' max '5 kg'
on Set -> set W = '6 [lb_av]'
event Set

desc: Explicit counting-unit mismatches (e.g. `each` vs `box`) are not meaningfully comparable without a conversion field and must not be proved by same-dimension fallback.
exercise:
field A as quantity in 'each'
field B as quantity in 'box' max '5 box'
on Set -> set B = A
event Set

desc: An unprovable obligation is not treated as probably-fine; it surfaces a compile-time diagnostic requiring an added proof-bearing fact.
exercise:
field N as decimal
rule 100 / N > 0 because "..."
